#!/bin/sh
# Run the agent locally against the public scouting sites (headless) and record it in experiments/local-runs.jsonl
# (gitignored). Usage, from anywhere: dev/run-local.sh <version> ["note"] [experiment]
# Needs `atira login` and `atira models proxy` running in another terminal. HEADLESS=0 shows the browser.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1
version=${1:?usage: dev/run-local.sh <version> [note] [experiment]}
note=${2:-}
experiment=${3:-}
curl -s --max-time 5 -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8765/ || {
  echo "The models proxy is not running: start \`atira models proxy\` in another terminal first."; exit 1; }
commit=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
dirty=no; [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- agent)" ] && dirty=yes
traces="$PWD/agent/traces/$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$traces"
eval "$(atira scout --env)"
(cd agent && uv sync -q && HEADLESS=${HEADLESS:-1} TRACE_DIR="$traces" uv run --no-sync python agent.py)
status=$?
trace=$(ls "$traces"/run-*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -n "$trace" ] || { echo "The agent wrote no trace; nothing recorded."; exit $status; }
python3 dev/track.py local --trace "$trace" --version "$version" --experiment "$experiment" --note "$note" \
  --commit "$commit" --dirty "$dirty" && python3 dev/track.py report
exit $status

            except Exception as error:
                await asyncio.sleep(1.0)
                self.view = await observe(page, str(self.stamp)) if not page.is_closed() else f"(page error {error})"
        header = [f"URL: {page.url}", f"Title: {await page.title()}"]
        if len(self.pages) > 1:
            header.append(f"Windows open: {len(self.pages)} (you are in the newest)")
        if self.events:
            header.append("Since your last action: " + "; ".join(self.events))
            self.events.clear()
        if offset == 0:
            self.trace.event(self.name, "view", quiet=True, url=page.url, text=self.view)
            self.seen += "\n" + self.view
        text = self.view[offset:offset + MAX_VIEW]
        rest = len(self.view) - offset - len(text)
        if rest > 0:
            text += f"\n[... {rest} more characters: read_more(offset={offset + len(text)})]"
        return "\n".join(header) + "\n\n" + text

    async def act(self, kind: str, ref: str, fn) -> str:
        """Run one action on the element `ref`, settle, and return the new view."""
        async with self.lock:
            element = await locate(self.page, ref)
            if element is None:
                return f"No element {ref} on this page (refs change with every view).\n\n" + await self.look()
            started = time.monotonic()
            before = (self.page.url, self.view)
            try:
                await fn(element)
            except Exception as error:
                first = str(error).splitlines()[0][:200]
                self.trace.event(self.name, "action_error", action=kind, ref=ref, error=first)
                return f"{kind} {ref} failed: {first}\n\n" + await self.look()
            await asyncio.sleep(0.25)
            await self.settle()
            self.trace.event(self.name, "action", action=kind, ref=ref, seconds=round(time.monotonic() - started, 2))
            view = await self.look()
            if (self.page.url, self.view) == before:
                view = (f"Nothing on the page changed after {kind} {ref}. Do not repeat it; check the page for what "
                        f"is still missing (a required field, a checkbox, another button).\n\n") + view
            return view


async def _click(element) -> None:
    try:
        await element.click(timeout=5000)
    except Exception:
        await element.evaluate("e => e.click()")  # covered by a banner or outside the scroll box


@dataclass
class Deps:
    """What a worker's tools reach: its website and the notes it keeps for the orchestrator."""

    session: SiteSession
    notes: dict[str, str] = field(default_factory=dict)
    refused: dict[str, int] = field(default_factory=dict)


async def goto(ctx: RunContext[Deps], url: str) -> str:
    """Open a URL or a path on this website (e.g. a link's target from the page)."""
    session = ctx.deps.session
    target = urljoin(session.page.url, url)
    if urlparse(target).netloc != urlparse(session.site["url"]).netloc:
        return f"{target} is not on this website ({session.site['url']}); stay on it."
    async with session.lock:
        await session._goto(target)
        session.trace.event(session.name, "action", action="goto", url=target)
        return await session.look()


async def click(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str) -> str:
    """Click the element with this ref (link, button, tab, summary, checkbox)."""
    return await ctx.deps.session.act("click", ref, _click)


async def fill(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str, text: str, submit: bool = False) -> str:
    """Type text into a textbox or textarea (replaces its content), or set a slider to a number.

    submit=true presses Enter afterwards, which runs a search or sends the field's form.
    """
    async def run(element):
        if await element.evaluate("e => e.type") == "range":
            await element.evaluate("(e, v) => { e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true}));"
                                   " e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', {bubbles: true})); }", text)
        else:
            await element.fill(text, timeout=5000)
        if submit:
            await element.press("Enter")
    return await ctx.deps.session.act("fill", ref, run)


async def select(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str, option: str) -> str:
    """Choose an option of a select by its visible text."""
    async def run(element):
        try:
            await element.select_option(label=option, timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            await element.select_option(option, timeout=5000)
    return await ctx.deps.session.act("select", ref, run)


async def check(ctx: RunContext[Deps], ref: str, checked: bool = True) -> str:
    """Tick (checked=true) or untick a checkbox or radio button."""
    async def run(element):
        try:
            await element.set_checked(checked, timeout=5000)
        except Exception:
            await element.evaluate("(e, c) => { if (e.checked !== c) e.click(); }", checked)
    return await ctx.deps.session.act("check", ref, run)


async def back(ctx: RunContext[Deps]) -> str:
    """Go back to the previous page."""
    session = ctx.deps.session
    async with session.lock:
        try:
            await session.page.go_back(wait_until="domcontentloaded", timeout=15000)
        except Exception:
            pass
        await session.settle()
        return await session.look()


async def read_more(ctx: RunContext[Deps], offset: int) -> str:
    """Show the rest of a long page from the offset the view gave."""
    return await ctx.deps.session.look(offset)


VALUE = re.compile(r"[\w/.:,+-]*\d[\w/.:,+-]*")


def unseen_values(text: str, seen: str) -> list[str]:
    """The values in `text` (anything with a digit: numbers, references, dates) that `seen` does not contain."""
    haystack = " ".join(seen.split())
    missing = []
    for token in VALUE.findall(text):
        token = token.strip(".,:;/-+")
        if token and token not in haystack and token not in missing:
            missing.append(token)
    return missing


async def note(ctx: RunContext[Deps], key: str, value: str) -> str:
    """Record a fact you can see on the current page (copy values exactly), so it survives if you run out of time."""
    missing = unseen_values(value, ctx.deps.session.seen)
    if missing:
        ctx.deps.session.trace.event(ctx.deps.session.name, "note_refused", key=key, missing=missing[:10])
        ctx.deps.refused[key] = ctx.deps.refused.get(key, 0) + 1
        if ctx.deps.refused[key] > 2:
            return (f"Not noted, again. Stop trying to note {key!r}; continue with your goal from what the current "
                    f"page shows.")
        return (f"Not noted: {', '.join(missing[:10])} appear on no page you have seen. Note only values copied "
                f"from a page; open the page again if you need to check.")
    ctx.deps.notes[key] = value
    ctx.deps.session.trace.event(ctx.deps.session.name, "note", key=key, value=value)
    return f"noted {key}"

#!/bin/sh
# Run the agent locally against the public scouting sites (headless) and record it in experiments/local-runs.jsonl
# (gitignored). Usage, from anywhere: dev/run-local.sh <version> ["note"] [experiment]
# Needs `atira login` and `atira models proxy` running in another terminal. HEADLESS=0 shows the browser.
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 1
version=${1:?usage: dev/run-local.sh <version> [note] [experiment]}
note=${2:-}
experiment=${3:-}
curl -s --max-time 5 -o /dev/null http://127.0.0.1:8765/ || {
  echo "The models proxy is not running: start \`atira models proxy\` in another terminal first."; exit 1; }
commit=$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)
dirty=no; [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- agent)" ] && dirty=yes
traces="$PWD/agent/traces/$(date -u +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$traces"
eval "$(atira scout --env)"
(cd agent && uv sync -q && HEADLESS=${HEADLESS:-1} TRACE_DIR="$traces" uv run --no-sync python agent.py)
status=$?
trace=$(ls "$traces"/run-*.jsonl 2>/dev/null | head -1)
[ -n "$trace" ] || { echo "The agent wrote no trace; nothing recorded."; exit $status; }
python3 dev/track.py local --trace "$trace" --version "$version" --experiment "$experiment" --note "$note" \
  --commit "$commit" --dirty "$dirty" && python3 dev/track.py report
exit $status

"""
Quick decisions with Cloudflare Clef, the hosted decision model, beside Qwen.

Clef answers fixed-form questions about a state in about a second: `choice` picks one of our options, `noul` gives the
probability of yes. Off unless USE_CLEF=1, so runs with and without it compare side by side (agent.json "models" then
lists "clef" too). Every helper returns None when Clef is off or fails, and the caller goes on without it.

Measured on page views from our own traces (dev/clef_eval): Clef is no better than Qwen at picking a link or at
judging whether a document or record is the right one, but it is reliable and fast at "did that action work / is this
an error or dead-end page". So workers get `page_check`, a validator they may call on the current page.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time

import httpx2 as httpx
from pydantic_ai import RunContext

TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get("CLEF_TIMEOUT", "20"))
MAX_STATE = 12000  # characters of page text sent; Clef reads text far shorter than Qwen's context
_limit = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("CLEF_CONCURRENCY", "12")))  # team limit is 16 at once
ELEMENT = re.compile(r"\[(e\d+) (link|button|summary|tab|menuitem)\b([^\]]*)\]")


def enabled() -> bool:
    return os.environ.get("USE_CLEF") == "1" and bool(os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"))


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[str] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict | None:
    """One /v1/decide call: the raw answers by question key, or None after `retries` failed attempts."""
    if not os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"):
        return None
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = images[:4]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('CLEF_API_KEY', '')}", "User-Agent": "error404ai-rfq-agent"}
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            async with _limit, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=TIMEOUT) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            print(f"[clef] {response.status_code} {time.monotonic() - started:.1f}s "
                  f"{data.get('usage', {}).get('input_tokens', '?')} tokens", flush=True)
            return data["answers"]
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"[clef] failed ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})", flush=True)
            if attempt < retries:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
    return None


def options_from_view(view: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The links and buttons of a page view by ref, each with the words of its row, for a `choice` question."""
    options: dict[str, str] = {}
    lines = view.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        matches = list(ELEMENT.finditer(line))
        if not matches:
            continue
        row = ELEMENT.sub(lambda m: m.group(3).strip(), line).strip()
        if len(ELEMENT.sub("", line).strip(" |-")) < 3 and i:  # a row of bare controls: name what precedes it
            row = f"{lines[i - 1].strip()[:120]} / {row}"
        for m in matches:
            options[m.group(1)] = f"{m.group(2)} {m.group(3).strip()}  (row: {row[:240]})"
    return options


async def choose(view: str, goal: str, options: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
    """Which option (by key) best serves `goal` on this view, and Clef's probability for it."""
    options = options or options_from_view(view)
    if not options:
        return None
    answers = await decide({"goal": goal, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]},

"""
Clef vs Qwen on hand-labelled decisions from real page views (dev/clef_eval/data/items.json, local and gitignored).

Decision types: `choice` (which link or control serves a goal), `noul_doc` (right document, revision, record, date),
`noul_outcome` (is the page an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action), `prefilter` (which rows of a list
matter, one decision per row). Each model sees the same page text and question.

    uv run --project agent python dev/clef_eval/eval.py [--reps 2] [--only clef,qwen-off]

Needs `atira models proxy` (defaults to its local URLs). Prints a table and writes data/results.json.
"""
import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import os
import re
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent.parent / "agent"))
os.environ.setdefault("CLEF_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/clef")
os.environ.setdefault("CLEF_API_KEY", "local")
os.environ.setdefault("QWEN_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/qwen/v1")
os.environ.setdefault("QWEN_API_KEY", "local")

import clef  # noqa: E402
from openai import AsyncOpenAI  # noqa: E402

PRICE = {"clef_in": 0.24, "qwen_in": 0.15, "qwen_cached": 0.016, "qwen_out": 0.47}  # $ per M tokens
qwen = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"], timeout=120,
                   max_retries=3)
usage = {"clef_in": 0}


def clef_usage_hook():
    """Count Clef input tokens by wrapping clef.decide's HTTP response (usage comes back in the body)."""
    original = clef.decide

    async def counted(state, questions, images=None, retries=2):
        body = json.dumps({"state": state, "questions": questions}, ensure_ascii=False)
        usage["clef_chars"] = usage.get("clef_chars", 0) + len(body)
        return await original(state, questions, images, retries)
    clef.decide = counted


OUTCOME = clef.OUTCOME_QUESTION


def outcome_state(it):
    return {"last_action": it["action"], "page": it["page"][:clef.MAX_STATE]}


def doc_state(it):
    return {"context": it["scenario"], **({"record": it["state"]} if "state" in it else {"page": it["page"]})}


def options(it):
    return clef.options_from_view(it["page"])


# ---- Clef

async def clef_item(it, variant="batch"):
    t = it["type"]
    if t == "choice":
        r = await clef.choose(it["page"], f"{it['goal']} ({it['scenario']})", options(it))
        return [r[0] if r else None]
    if t == "noul_doc":
        p = await clef.yes(doc_state(it), it["q"])
        return [None if p is None else p >= 0.5]
    if t == "noul_outcome":
        p = await clef.yes(outcome_state(it), OUTCOME.format(action=it["action"]))
        return [None if p is None else p >= 0.5]
    if t == "prefilter":
        if variant == "row":
            ps = await asyncio.gather(*[clef.yes({"context": it["scenario"], "row": row},
                                                 f"Does this row: {it['criterion']}?") for row in it["rows"]])
        else:
            state = {"context": it["scenario"], "rows": {str(i + 1): r for i, r in enumerate(it["rows"])}}
            ps = await clef.yes_each(state, [f"Does row {i + 1}: {it['criterion']}?" for i in range(len(it["rows"]))])
        return [None if p is None else p >= 0.5 for p in (ps or [None] * len(it["rows"]))]


# ---- Qwen

async def ask(prompt: str, thinking: bool) -> str:
    reply = await qwen.chat.completions.create(
        model="qwen3.8-flash-next", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], temperature=0.2,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": thinking}})
    u = reply.usage
    cached = getattr(getattr(u, "prompt_tokens_details", None), "cached_tokens", 0) or 0
    usage["qwen_in"] = usage.get("qwen_in", 0) + u.prompt_tokens - cached
    usage["qwen_cached"] = usage.get("qwen_cached", 0) + cached

"""
Quick decisions with Cloudflare Clef, the hosted decision model, beside Qwen.

Clef answers fixed-form questions about a state in about a second: `choice` picks one of our options, `noul` gives the
probability of yes. Off unless USE_CLEF=1, so runs with and without it compare side by side (agent.json "models" then
lists "clef" too). Every helper returns None when Clef is off or fails, and the caller goes on without it.

Measured on page views from our own traces (dev/clef_eval): Clef is no better than Qwen at picking a link or at
judging whether a document or record is the right one, but it is reliable and fast at "did that action work / is this
an error or dead-end page". So workers get `page_check`, a validator they may call on the current page.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time

import httpx2 as httpx
from pydantic_ai import RunContext

TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get("CLEF_TIMEOUT", "20"))
MAX_STATE = 12000  # characters of page text sent; Clef reads text far shorter than Qwen's context
_limit = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("CLEF_CONCURRENCY", "12")))  # team limit is 16 at once
ELEMENT = re.compile(r"\[(e\d+) (link|button|summary|tab|menuitem)\b([^\]]*)\]")


def enabled() -> bool:
    return os.environ.get("USE_CLEF") == "1" and bool(os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"))


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[str] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict | None:
    """One /v1/decide call: the raw answers by question key, or None after `retries` failed attempts."""
    if not os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"):
        return None
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = images[:4]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('CLEF_API_KEY', '')}", "User-Agent": "error404ai-rfq-agent"}
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            async with _limit, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=TIMEOUT) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            print(f"[clef] {response.status_code} {time.monotonic() - started:.1f}s "
                  f"{data.get('usage', {}).get('input_tokens', '?')} tokens", flush=True)
            return data["answers"]
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"[clef] failed ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})", flush=True)
            if attempt < retries:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
    return None


def options_from_view(view: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The links and buttons of a page view by ref, each with the words of its row, for a `choice` question."""
    options: dict[str, str] = {}
    lines = view.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        matches = list(ELEMENT.finditer(line))
        if not matches:
            continue
        row = ELEMENT.sub(lambda m: m.group(3).strip(), line).strip()
        if len(ELEMENT.sub("", line).strip(" |-")) < 3 and i:  # a row of bare controls: name what precedes it
            row = f"{lines[i - 1].strip()[:120]} / {row}"
        for m in matches:
            options[m.group(1)] = f"{m.group(2)} {m.group(3).strip()}  (row: {row[:240]})"
    return options


async def choose(view: str, goal: str, options: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
    """Which option (by key) best serves `goal` on this view, and Clef's probability for it."""
    options = options or options_from_view(view)
    if not options:
        return None
    answers = await decide({"goal": goal, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]},
                           {"pick": {"type": "choice", "instructions": f"Which element should be used next to reach "
                                     f"the goal: {goal}", "criteria": options}})
    if not answers:
        return None
    pick = answers["pick"]
    return pick["choice"], pick.get("probabilities", {}).get(pick["choice"], pick.get("confidence", 0.0))


async def yes(state, question: str) -> float | None:
    """Clef's probability that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}})
    return None if answers is None else answers["q"]["noul"]


async def yes_each(state, questions: list[str]) -> list[float] | None:
    """Several yes/no questions about one state in one call (e.g. one per list row), in order."""
    answers = await decide(state, {f"q{i}": {"type": "noul", "instructions": q} for i, q in enumerate(questions)})
    return None if answers is None else [answers[f"q{i}"]["noul"] for i in range(len(questions))]


OUTCOME_QUESTION = ("Is this page an error, an empty result, a locked or expired state, a dead end or a decoy, rather "
                    "than real content that moves the task on? Last action: {action}")


async def page_check(ctx: RunContext, last_action: str) -> str:
    """Ask a fast second opinion whether the current page is an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action.

    Use it when unsure whether your last action worked, before relying on the page. `last_action` says what you
    did and expected, e.g. "searched the archive for the tender reference".
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    p = await yes({"last_action": last_action, "url": session.page.url, "page": session.view[:MAX_STATE]},
                  OUTCOME_QUESTION.format(action=last_action))
    session.trace.event(session.name, "clef", check="outcome", action=last_action[:120], p_error=p)
    if p is None:
        return "No second opinion available; judge the page yourself."
    if p >= 0.5:
        return f"Likely an error, empty, locked or decoy page (p={p:.2f}): go back or try another way."
    return f"Likely real content (p_error={p:.2f}); the action seems to have worked."


def tools() -> tuple:
    """Extra worker tools when Clef is on; pass to run_worker(tools=...)."""
    return (page_check,) if enabled() else ()

    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        matches = list(ELEMENT.finditer(line))
        if not matches:
            continue
        row = ELEMENT.sub(lambda m: m.group(3).strip(), line).strip()
        if len(ELEMENT.sub("", line).strip(" |-")) < 3 and i:  # a row of bare controls: name what precedes it
            row = f"{lines[i - 1].strip()[:120]} / {row}"
        for m in matches:
            options[m.group(1)] = f"{m.group(2)} {m.group(3).strip()}  (row: {row[:240]})"

    """Which option (by key) best serves `goal` on this view, and Clef's probability for it."""
    options = options or options_from_view(view)
    if not options:
        return None
    answers = await decide({"goal": goal, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]},
                           {"pick": {"type": "choice", "instructions": f"Which element should be used next to reach "
                                     f"the goal: {goal}", "criteria": options}})
    if not answers:
        return None
    pick = answers["pick"]
    return pick["choice"], pick.get("probabilities", {}).get(pick["choice"], pick.get("confidence", 0.0))

    """Clef's probability that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}})
    return None if answers is None else answers["q"]["noul"]


async def yes_each(state, questions: list[str]) -> list[float] | None:

    answers = await decide(state, {f"q{i}": {"type": "noul", "instructions": q} for i, q in enumerate(questions)})

OUTCOME_QUESTION = ("Is this page an error, an empty result, a locked or expired state, a dead end or a decoy, rather "
                    "than real content that moves the task on? Last action: {action}")


async def page_check(ctx: RunContext, last_action: str) -> str:
    """Ask a fast second opinion whether the current page is an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action.

    Use it when unsure whether your last action worked, before relying on the page. `last_action` says what you
    did and expected, e.g. "searched the archive for the tender reference".
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    p = await yes({"last_action": last_action, "url": session.page.url, "page": session.view[:MAX_STATE]},
                  OUTCOME_QUESTION.format(action=last_action))
    session.trace.event(session.name, "clef", check="outcome", action=last_action[:120], p_error=p)
    if p is None:
        return "No second opinion available; judge the page yourself."
    if p >= 0.5:
        return f"Likely an error, empty, locked or decoy page (p={p:.2f}): go back or try another way."
    return f"Likely real content (p_error={p:.2f}); the action seems to have worked."


def tools() -> tuple:
    """Extra worker tools when Clef is on; pass to run_worker(tools=...)."""
    return (page_check,) if enabled() else ()

"""
Clef vs Qwen on hand-labelled decisions from real page views (dev/clef_eval/data/items.json, local and gitignored).

Decision types: `choice` (which link or control serves a goal), `noul_doc` (right document, revision, record, date),
`noul_outcome` (is the page an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action), `prefilter` (which rows of a list
matter, one decision per row). Each model sees the same page text and question.

    uv run --project agent python dev/clef_eval/eval.py [--reps 2] [--only clef,qwen-off]

Needs `atira models proxy` (defaults to its local URLs). Prints a table and writes data/results.json.
"""
import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import os
import re
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent.parent / "agent"))
os.environ.setdefault("CLEF_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/clef")
os.environ.setdefault("CLEF_API_KEY", "local")
os.environ.setdefault("QWEN_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/qwen/v1")
os.environ.setdefault("QWEN_API_KEY", "local")

import clef  # noqa: E402
from openai import AsyncOpenAI  # noqa: E402

PRICE = {"clef_in": 0.24, "qwen_in": 0.15, "qwen_cached": 0.016, "qwen_out": 0.47}  # $ per M tokens
qwen = AsyncOpenAI(base_url=os.environ["QWEN_BASE_URL"], api_key=os.environ["QWEN_API_KEY"], timeout=120,
                   max_retries=3)
usage = {"clef_in": 0}


def clef_usage_hook():
    """Count Clef input tokens by wrapping clef.decide's HTTP response (usage comes back in the body)."""
    original = clef.decide

    async def counted(state, questions, images=None, retries=2):
        body = json.dumps({"state": state, "questions": questions}, ensure_ascii=False)
        usage["clef_chars"] = usage.get("clef_chars", 0) + len(body)
        return await original(state, questions, images, retries)
    clef.decide = counted


OUTCOME = clef.OUTCOME_QUESTION


def outcome_state(it):
    return {"last_action": it["action"], "page": it["page"][:clef.MAX_STATE]}


def doc_state(it):
    return {"context": it["scenario"], **({"record": it["state"]} if "state" in it else {"page": it["page"]})}


def options(it):
    return clef.options_from_view(it["page"])


# ---- Clef

async def clef_item(it, variant="batch"):
    t = it["type"]
    if t == "choice":
        r = await clef.choose(it["page"], f"{it['goal']} ({it['scenario']})", options(it))
        return [r[0] if r else None]
    if t == "noul_doc":
        p = await clef.yes(doc_state(it), it["q"])
        return [None if p is None else p >= 0.5]
    if t == "noul_outcome":
        p = await clef.yes(outcome_state(it), OUTCOME.format(action=it["action"]))
        return [None if p is None else p >= 0.5]
    if t == "prefilter":
        if variant == "row":
            ps = await asyncio.gather(*[clef.yes({"context": it["scenario"], "row": row},
                                                 f"Does this row: {it['criterion']}?") for row in it["rows"]])
        else:
            state = {"context": it["scenario"], "rows": {str(i + 1): r for i, r in enumerate(it["rows"])}}
            ps = await clef.yes_each(state, [f"Does row {i + 1}: {it['criterion']}?" for i in range(len(it["rows"]))])
        return [None if p is None else p >= 0.5 for p in (ps or [None] * len(it["rows"]))]


# ---- Qwen

async def ask(prompt: str, thinking: bool) -> str:
    reply = await qwen.chat.completions.create(
        model="qwen3.8-flash-next", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], temperature=0.2,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": thinking}})
    u = reply.usage
    cached = getattr(getattr(u, "prompt_tokens_details", None), "cached_tokens", 0) or 0
    usage["qwen_in"] = usage.get("qwen_in", 0) + u.prompt_tokens - cached
    usage["qwen_cached"] = usage.get("qwen_cached", 0) + cached
    usage["qwen_out"] = usage.get("qwen_out", 0) + u.completion_tokens
    return reply.choices[0].message.content or ""


def yesno(text: str):
    m = re.search(r"\b(yes|no|ja|nein)\b", text.lower())
    return None if not m else m.group(1) in ("yes", "ja")


async def qwen_item(it, thinking):
    t = it["type"]
    head = f"You decide one step for a web agent. {it['scenario']}\n\n"
    if t == "choice":
        opts = "\n".join(f"{k}: {v}" for k, v in options(it).items())
        text = await ask(f"{head}Goal: {it['goal']}\n\nPage:\n{it['page']}\n\nOptions:\n{opts}\n\nWhich element "
                         f"should be used next to reach the goal? Answer with its key only (e.g. e3).", thinking)
        m = re.search(r"\be\d+\b", text)
        return [m.group(0) if m else None]
    if t == "noul_doc":
        body = f"Record:\n{it['state']}" if "state" in it else f"Page:\n{it['page']}"
        return [yesno(await ask(f"{head}{body}\n\nQuestion: {it['q']} Answer yes or no only.", thinking))]
    if t == "noul_outcome":
        return [yesno(await ask(f"{head}Page:\n{it['page']}\n\nQuestion: {OUTCOME.format(action=it['action'])} "
                                f"Answer yes or no only.", thinking))]
    if t == "prefilter":
        rows = "\n\n".join(f"Row {i + 1}:\n{r}" for i, r in enumerate(it["rows"]))
        text = await ask(f"{head}{rows}\n\nWhich rows {it['criterion']}? Answer with a JSON list of row numbers "
                         f"only, e.g. [1, 3], or [] for none.", thinking)
        m = re.search(r"\[[\d,\s]*\]", text)
        picked = set(json.loads(m.group(0))) if m else None
        return [None if picked is None else (i + 1) in picked for i in range(len(it["rows"]))]


METHODS = {
    "clef": lambda it: clef_item(it, "batch"),
    "clef-row": lambda it: clef_item(it, "row"),
    "qwen-off": lambda it: qwen_item(it, False),
    "qwen-on": lambda it: qwen_item(it, True),
}


def correct(it, answers):
    if it["type"] == "choice":
        return [answers[0] in it["ok"]]
    if it["type"] == "prefilter":
        return [a == label for a, label in zip(answers, it["labels"])]
    return [answers[0] == it["ans"]]


async def run(method, items, reps, parallel=4):
    gate = asyncio.Semaphore(parallel)
    records = []

    async def one(i, it, rep):
        async with gate:
            started = time.monotonic()
            try:
                answers = await METHODS[method](it)
            except Exception as error:
                print(f"  {method} item {i} failed: {error}", flush=True)
                answers = [None] * (len(it["rows"]) if it["type"] == "prefilter" else 1)
            seconds = time.monotonic() - started
            records.append({"method": method, "item": i, "rep": rep, "type": it["type"], "seconds": seconds,
                            "answers": answers, "correct": correct(it, answers)})

    await asyncio.gather(*[one(i, it, rep) for rep in range(reps) for i, it in enumerate(items)])
    return records


async def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--reps", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--only", default="clef,clef-row,qwen-off,qwen-on")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    items = json.loads((HERE / "data" / "items.json").read_text())
    clef_usage_hook()
    results = {}
    for method in args.only.split(","):
        before = dict(usage)
        recs = await run(method, items, args.reps)
        spent = {k: usage.get(k, 0) - before.get(k, 0) for k in usage}
        results[method] = {"records": recs, "usage": spent}
        print(f"{method}: done", flush=True)
    (HERE / "data" / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=1, default=str))
    table(results, items, args.reps)


def table(results, items, reps):
    types = ["choice", "noul_doc", "noul_outcome", "prefilter"]
    print(f"\n{'type':<14}{'method':<10}{'acc':>12}{'med s':>8}{'p90 s':>8}")
    for t in types:
        for method, res in results.items():
            recs = [r for r in res["records"] if r["type"] == t]
            if not recs:
                continue
            ok = sum(sum(r["correct"]) for r in recs)
            n = sum(len(r["correct"]) for r in recs)
            secs = sorted(r["seconds"] for r in recs)
            p90 = secs[min(len(secs) - 1, int(0.9 * len(secs)))]
            print(f"{t:<14}{method:<10}{f'{ok}/{n} {100 * ok / n:.0f}%':>12}{statistics.median(secs):>8.2f}"
                  f"{p90:>8.2f}")
    print("\ncost per decision call (simulated $):")
    for method, res in results.items():
        u = res["usage"]
        calls = len(res["records"])
        if method.startswith("clef"):
            tokens = u.get("clef_chars", 0) / 3.2  # Clef reports tokens per call; chars/3.2 ~ observed ratio
            cost = tokens * PRICE["clef_in"] / 1e6
        else:
            cost = (u.get("qwen_in", 0) * PRICE["qwen_in"] + u.get("qwen_cached", 0) * PRICE["qwen_cached"]
                    + u.get("qwen_out", 0) * PRICE["qwen_out"]) / 1e6
        print(f"  {method:<10} ${cost / calls:.6f} per item ({calls} items, usage {u})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

        r = await clef.choose(it["page"], f"{it['goal']} ({it['scenario']})", options(it))
        return [r[0] if r else None]
    if t == "noul_doc":
        p = await clef.yes(doc_state(it), it["q"])
        return [None if p is None else p >= 0.5]
    if t == "noul_outcome":
        p = await clef.yes(outcome_state(it), OUTCOME.format(action=it["action"]))
        return [None if p is None else p >= 0.5]
    if t == "prefilter":
        if variant == "row":
            ps = await asyncio.gather(*[clef.yes({"context": it["scenario"], "row": row},
                                                 f"Does this row: {it['criterion']}?") for row in it["rows"]])

            ps = await clef.yes_each(state, [f"Does row {i + 1}: {it['criterion']}?" for i in range(len(it["rows"]))])

async def ask(prompt: str, thinking: bool) -> str:
    reply = await qwen.chat.completions.create(
        model="qwen3.8-flash-next", messages=[{"role": "user", "content": prompt}], temperature=0.2,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": thinking}})
    u = reply.usage
    cached = getattr(getattr(u, "prompt_tokens_details", None), "cached_tokens", 0) or 0

    return None if not m else m.group(1) in ("yes", "ja")

    t = it["type"]

                  f"{p90:>8.2f}")

    for method, res in results.items():
        u = res["usage"]
        calls = len(res["records"])
        if method.startswith("clef"):

        else:

                    + u.get("qwen_out", 0) * PRICE["qwen_out"]) / 1e6
        print(f"  {method:<10} ${cost / calls:.6f} per item ({calls} items, usage {u})")

    asyncio.run(main())

        return [a == label for a, label in zip(answers, it["labels"])]
    return [answers[0] == it["ans"]]


async def run(method, items, reps, parallel=4):
    gate = asyncio.Semaphore(parallel)
    records = []

    async def one(i, it, rep):
        async with gate:
            started = time.monotonic()
            try:
                answers = await METHODS[method](it)
            except Exception as error:
                print(f"  {method} item {i} failed: {error}", flush=True)
                answers = [None] * (len(it["rows"]) if it["type"] == "prefilter" else 1)
            seconds = time.monotonic() - started
            records.append({"method": method, "item": i, "rep": rep, "type": it["type"], "seconds": seconds,
                            "answers": answers, "correct": correct(it, answers)})

    await asyncio.gather(*[one(i, it, rep) for rep in range(reps) for i, it in enumerate(items)])
    return records


async def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--reps", type=int, default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--only", default="clef,clef-row,qwen-off,qwen-on")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    items = json.loads((HERE / "data" / "items.json").read_text())
    results = {}
    for method in args.only.split(","):
        before = {**usage, "clef_in": clef.USAGE["input_tokens"]}
        recs = await run(method, items, args.reps)
        usage["clef_in"] = clef.USAGE["input_tokens"]
        spent = {k: usage.get(k, 0) - before.get(k, 0) for k in usage}
        results[method] = {"records": recs, "usage": spent}
        print(f"{method}: done", flush=True)
    (HERE / "data" / "results.json").write_text(json.dumps(results, indent=1, default=str))
    table(results, items, args.reps)


def table(results, items, reps):
    types = ["choice", "noul_doc", "noul_outcome", "prefilter"]
    print(f"\n{'type':<14}{'method':<10}{'acc':>12}{'med s':>8}{'p90 s':>8}")
    for t in types:
        for method, res in results.items():
            recs = [r for r in res["records"] if r["type"] == t]
            if not recs:
                continue
            ok = sum(sum(r["correct"]) for r in recs)
            n = sum(len(r["correct"]) for r in recs)
            secs = sorted(r["seconds"] for r in recs)
            p90 = secs[min(len(secs) - 1, int(0.9 * len(secs)))]
            print(f"{t:<14}{method:<10}{f'{ok}/{n} {100 * ok / n:.0f}%':>12}{statistics.median(secs):>8.2f}"
                  f"{p90:>8.2f}")
    print("\ncost per decision call (simulated $):")
    for method, res in results.items():
        u = res["usage"]
        calls = len(res["records"])
        if method.startswith("clef"):
            cost = u.get("clef_in", 0) * PRICE["clef_in"] / 1e6
        else:
            cost = (u.get("qwen_in", 0) * PRICE["qwen_in"] + u.get("qwen_cached", 0) * PRICE["qwen_cached"]
                    + u.get("qwen_out", 0) * PRICE["qwen_out"]) / 1e6
        print(f"  {method:<10} ${cost / calls:.6f} per item ({calls} items, usage {u})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    asyncio.run(main())

entries.name: Monitor
entries.description:
Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Each stdout line is an event — you keep working and notifications arrive in the chat. Events arrive on their own schedule and are not replies from the user, even if one lands while you're waiting for the user to answer a question.

Pick by how many notifications you need:
- **One** ("tell me when the server is ready / the build finishes") → use **Bash with `run_in_background`** and a command that exits when the condition is true, e.g. `until grep -q "Ready in" dev.log; do sleep 0.5; done`. You get a single completion notification when it exits.
- **One per occurrence, until the monitor expires (re-arm to continue)** ("tell me every time an ERROR line appears") → Monitor with an unbounded command (`tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, `while true`).
- **One per occurrence, until a known end** ("emit each CI step result, stop when the run completes") → Monitor with a command that emits lines and then exits.

Your script's stdout is the event stream. Each line becomes a notification. Exit ends the watch.

  # Each matching log line is an event
  tail -f /var/log/app.log | grep --line-buffered "ERROR"

  # Each file change is an event
  inotifywait -m --format '%e %f' /watched/dir

  # Poll GitHub for new PR comments and emit one line per new comment
  last=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  while true; do
    now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
    gh api "repos/owner/repo/issues/123/comments?since=$last" --jq '.[] | "\(.user.login): \(.body)"'
    last=$now; sleep 30
  done

  # Node script that emits events as they arrive (e.g. WebSocket listener)
  node watch-for-events.js

  # Per-occurrence with a natural end: emit each CI check as it lands, exit when the run completes
  prev=""
  while true; do
    s=$(gh pr checks 123 --json name,bucket)
    cur=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.bucket!="pending") | "\(.name): \(.bucket)"' <<<"$s" | sort)
    comm -13 <(echo "$prev") <(echo "$cur")
    prev=$cur
    jq -e 'all(.bucket!="pending")' <<<"$s" >/dev/null && break
    sleep 30
  done

**Don't use an unbounded command for a single notification.** `tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, and `while true` never exit on their own, so the monitor stays armed until timeout even after the event has fired. For "tell me when X is ready," use Bash `run_in_background` with an `until` loop instead (one notification, ends in seconds). Note that `tail -f log | grep -m 1 ...` does *not* fix this: if the log goes quiet after the match, `tail` never receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline hangs anyway.

**Script quality:**
- Every pipe stage must flush per line or matches sit in its buffer unseen: `grep` needs `--line-buffered`, `awk` needs `fflush()`. `head` cannot flush at all — `| head -N` delivers nothing until N matches accumulate, then ends the stream.
- In poll loops, handle transient failures (`curl ... || true`) — one failed request shouldn't kill the monitor.
- Poll intervals: 30s+ for remote APIs (rate limits), 0.5-1s for local checks.
- Write a specific `description` — it appears in every notification ("errors in deploy.log" not "watching logs").
- Only stdout is the event stream. Stderr goes to the output file (readable via Read) but does not trigger notifications — for a command you run directly (e.g. `python train.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered ...`), merge stderr with `2>&1` so its failures reach your filter. (No effect on `tail -f` of an existing log — that file only contains what its writer redirected.)

**Coverage — silence is not success.** When watching a job or process for an outcome, your filter must match every terminal state, not just the happy path. A monitor that greps only for the success marker stays silent through a crashloop, a hung process, or an unexpected exit — and silence looks identical to "still running." Before arming, ask: *if this process crashed right now, would my filter emit anything?* If not, widen it.

  # Wrong — silent on crash, hang, or any non-success exit
  tail -f run.log | grep --line-buffered "elapsed_steps="

  # Right — one alternation covering progress + the failure signatures you'd act on
  tail -f run.log | grep -E --line-buffered "elapsed_steps=|Traceback|Error|FAILED|assert|Killed|OOM"

For poll loops checking job state, emit on every terminal status (`succeeded|failed|cancelled|timeout`), not just success. If you cannot confidently enumerate the failure signatures, broaden the grep alternation rather than narrow it — some extra noise is better than missing a crashloop.

**Output volume**: Every stdout line is a conversation message, so the filter should be selective — but selective means "the lines you'd act on," not "only good news." Never pipe raw logs; filter to exactly the success and failure signals you care about. Monitors that produce too many events are automatically stopped; restart with a tighter filter if this happens.

Stdout lines within 200ms are batched into a single notification, so multiline output from a single event groups naturally.

The script runs in the same shell environment as Bash. Exit ends the watch (exit code is reported). Every monitor expires after `timeout_ms` (default 5 minutes, at most 30 minutes): it is killed and you get one notice with the event count. Re-arm it if you still need the watch; for a long watch (PR monitoring, log tails) set `timeout_ms` to the maximum and re-arm on each expiry, and widen the filter if an expiry with no events was unexpected. Use TaskStop to cancel early.
**ws source** — open a WebSocket and stream each incoming text frame as an event. No shell, no polling: the server pushes, you get notified.

  Monitor({
    ws: {url: 'wss://events.example.com/stream', protocols: ['v1']},
    description: 'deploy events',
  })

Each text frame becomes one notification (multiline frames stay as one event). Binary frames are reported as `[binary frame, N bytes]` rather than passed through. Socket close ends the watch with the close code surfaced; errors are surfaced before close. Same rate limiting as bash — a firehose will be suppressed and eventually stopped, so subscribe to a filtered feed where one exists.

Prefer this over `command: 'websocat wss://…'` — it avoids the extra process and line-buffering pitfalls. Use bash when you need to transform or filter frames with shell tools before they become events.

When an event lands that the user would want to act on now — an error appeared, the status they were waiting on flipped — send a PushNotification. Not every event is worth a push; the ones that change what they'd do next are.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).

timeout_ms.description: Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms. Deadlines above 1800000ms are capped to 1800000ms. You are notified at expiry and can re-arm.

command.description: Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.

ws.description: WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. Cannot be combined with command.

"""Builds items.json from trace views (local only, gitignored): hand labels for the Clef vs Qwen eval."""
import glob
import json
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

TRACES = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "/Users/jonasstenglein/.claude/jobs/064ce75e/tmp/traces"
seen = {}
for f in sorted(glob.glob(f"{TRACES}/*.jsonl")):
    for line in open(f):
        e = json.loads(line)
        if e.get("kind") == "view":
            key = e["text"][:3000]
            if key not in seen:
                seen[key] = e
V = [e["text"] for e in seen.values()]
SCEN = "Scenario date 25.01.2027. Our company: Linden Hydraulik und Komponenten GmbH. Tender reference VG-2027-7093."
items = []


def choice(i, goal, ok):
    items.append({"type": "choice", "view": i, "goal": goal, "ok": ok})


def doc(i, q, ans, state=None):
    items.append({"type": "noul_doc", "view": i, "q": q, "ans": ans, **({"state": state} if state else {})})


def outcome(i, action, error):
    items.append({"type": "noul_outcome", "view": i, "action": action, "ans": error})


def prefilter(i, criterion, rows, labels):
    items.append({"type": "prefilter", "view": i, "criterion": criterion, "rows": rows, "labels": labels})


# which link or control to use
choice(47, "Open the tender with reference VG-2027-7093.", ["e9"])
choice(47, "Open the tender with reference VG-2027-6710.", ["e11"])
choice(103, "Open the bill of quantities document (Leistungsverzeichnis).", ["e8", "e10"])
choice(103, "Open the position overview document (Positionsübersicht).", ["e16", "e17"])

       ["e18"])
choice(160, "Open the Signatur-TAN mail with the highest request number (the newest TAN).", ["e16", "e8"])
choice(14, "Open the stock overview (Bestandsübersicht, MMBE).", ["e11"])
choice(15, "Open the price conditions (Konditionen, VK13).", ["e8", "e17"])
choice(113, "Open the technical specification (Lastenheft) for tender VG-2027-7093.", ["e11"])
choice(59, "Find the technical specification (Lastenheft) for tender VG-2027-7093 in the register.", ["e10"])
choice(123, "Leave this position out of the bid (no matching material).", ["e20"])

# right document / record / revision / sender
REV = "Does the document view (the frame) show the revision that is currently valid (gültig)?"
doc(81, REV, False)
doc(83, REV, True)
doc(85, REV, False)
doc(101, REV, False)
doc(69, "Does this page list the tender's positions with their quantities?", True)
doc(63, "Is this page the technical specification for tender VG-2027-7093?", False)
doc(66, "Does the result list contain the technical specification for tender VG-2027-7093?", False)
doc(113, "Does the result list contain the technical specification for tender VG-2027-7093?", True)
doc(26, "Does the opened message approve a discount for this bid?", False)
doc(26, "Is the opened message a signature TAN for tender VG-2027-7093?", True)
doc(82, "Has the answer to question 8152 been withdrawn according to this page?", True)
doc(161, "Is this record for exactly tender VG-2027-7093 (not a look-alike reference)?", False,
    "Mail: subject 'Verpackungstarife VG-2027-7093-A', from logistik@linden-hydraulik.example, received 25.01.2027.")
doc(161, "Is this record for exactly tender VG-2027-7093 (not a look-alike reference)?", True,
    "Mail: subject 'Verpackungstarife VG-2027-7093', from logistik@linden-hydraulik.example, received 24.01.2027.")
doc(161, "Is this record dated no later than the scenario date 25.01.2027?", False,
    "Mail: subject 'Devisenfixing VG-2027-7093', from finanzen@linden-hydraulik.example, received 26.01.2027.")
doc(161, "Is this record dated no later than the scenario date 25.01.2027?", True,
    "Mail: subject 'Verpackungstarife VG-2027-7093', from logistik@linden-hydraulik.example, received 24.01.2027.")
doc(86, "Do the answers on this page state a binding total quantity of 26 Satz for position 01.05?", True)

# did the action work / error or decoy page
outcome(72, "opened a document link", True)
outcome(174, "clicked 'Öffnen' next to the mailbox export notice", True)
outcome(183, "opened a message by its direct address", True)

outcome(1, "opened the ERP after login", True)
outcome(14, "unlocked the ERP notice", False)
outcome(148, "searched the archive folder with an empty search", True)
outcome(60, "expanded the actions menu of a register row", False)
outcome(83, "opened a specification revision", False)
outcome(161, "searched the archive for the tender reference", False)

# pre-filter list rows


def qa_rows(view):
    parts = re.split(r"\n(?=\[img: \d{4}\])", V[view])
    return [p.strip() for p in parts[1:]]


rows82 = qa_rows(82)
rows82[-1] = rows82[-1].split("Seite ")[0]
prefilter(82, "concerns position 01.05", rows82, [True, False, False, True, False, False])
rows86 = qa_rows(86)
rows86[-1] = rows86[-1].split("Seite ")[0]
prefilter(86, "concerns position 01.05", rows86, [True, True, True])
rows87 = qa_rows(87)
rows87[-1] = rows87[-1].split("Seite ")[0]
prefilter(87, "concerns position 01.03", rows87, [True, False, True])
mail = re.findall(r"\[e1[234] link [^\n]+\n[^\n]+\n[^\n]+", V[161])
prefilter(161, "is a packaging tariff (Verpackungstarife) mail for exactly tender VG-2027-7093", mail,
          [False, False, True])
tenders = re.findall(r"\[img: VG-[^\n]+", V[47])
prefilter(47, "is tender VG-2027-7093", tenders, [True, False, False])

for it in items:
    it["page"] = V[it["view"]]
    it["scenario"] = SCEN
Path(__file__).with_name("items.json").write_text(json.dumps(items, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))
print(len(items), "items;", sum(len(i["rows"]) if i["type"] == "prefilter" else 1 for i in items), "decisions")

"""
Clef vs Qwen on hand-labelled decisions from real page views (dev/clef_eval/data/items.json, local and gitignored).

Decision types: `choice` (which link or control serves a goal), `noul_doc` (right document, revision, record, date),
`noul_outcome` (is the page an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action), `prefilter` (which rows of a list
matter, one decision per row). Each model sees the same page text and question.

    uv run --project agent python dev/clef_eval/eval.py [--reps 2] [--only clef,qwen-off]

Needs `atira models proxy` (defaults to its local URLs). Prints a table and writes data/results.json.
"""
import argparse
import asyncio
import json
import os
import re
import statistics
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(HERE.parent.parent / "agent"))
os.environ.setdefault("CLEF_BASE_URL", "http://127.0.0.1:8765/clef")
os.environ.setdefault("CLEF_API_KEY", "local")

"""
Quick decisions with Cloudflare Clef, the hosted decision model, beside Qwen.

Clef answers fixed-form questions about a state in about a second: `choice` picks one of our options, `noul` gives the
probability of yes. Off unless USE_CLEF=1, so runs with and without it compare side by side (agent.json "models" then
lists "clef" too). Every helper returns None when Clef is off or fails, and the caller goes on without it.

Measured on page views from our own traces (dev/clef_eval): Clef is no better than Qwen at picking a link or at
judging whether a document or record is the right one, but it is reliable and fast at "did that action work / is this
an error or dead-end page". So workers get `page_check`, a validator they may call on the current page.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time

import httpx2 as httpx
from pydantic_ai import RunContext

TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get("CLEF_TIMEOUT", "20"))
MAX_STATE = 12000  # characters of page text sent; Clef reads text far shorter than Qwen's context
_limit = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("CLEF_CONCURRENCY", "12")))  # team limit is 16 at once
USAGE = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0, "seconds": 0.0}  # this process's Clef use, for the trace and cost
ELEMENT = re.compile(r"\[(e\d+) (link|button|summary|tab|menuitem)\b([^\]]*)\]")


def enabled() -> bool:
    return os.environ.get("USE_CLEF") == "1" and bool(os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"))

"""
Quick decisions with Cloudflare Clef, the hosted decision model, beside Qwen.

Clef answers fixed-form questions about a state in about a second: `choice` picks one of our options, `noul` gives the
probability of yes. Off unless USE_CLEF=1, so runs with and without it compare side by side (agent.json "models" then
lists "clef" too). Every helper returns None when Clef is off or fails, and the caller goes on without it.

Measured on page views from our own traces (dev/clef_eval): Clef is no better than Qwen at picking a link or at
judging whether a document or record is the right one, but it is reliable and fast at "did that action work / is this
an error or dead-end page". So workers get `page_check`, a validator they may call on the current page.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time

import httpx2 as httpx
from pydantic_ai import RunContext

TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get("CLEF_TIMEOUT", "20"))
MAX_STATE = 12000  # characters of page text sent; Clef reads text far shorter than Qwen's context
_limit = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("CLEF_CONCURRENCY", "12")))  # team limit is 16 at once
USAGE = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0, "seconds": 0.0}  # this process's Clef use, for the trace and cost
ELEMENT = re.compile(r"\[(e\d+) (link|button|summary|tab|menuitem)\b([^\]]*)\]")


def enabled() -> bool:
    return os.environ.get("USE_CLEF") == "1" and bool(os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"))


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[str] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict | None:
    """One /v1/decide call: the raw answers by question key, or None after `retries` failed attempts."""
    if not os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"):
        return None
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = images[:4]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('CLEF_API_KEY', '')}", "User-Agent": "error404ai-rfq-agent"}
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            async with _limit, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=TIMEOUT) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            tokens = data.get("usage", {}).get("input_tokens", 0)
            USAGE["calls"] += 1
            USAGE["input_tokens"] += tokens
            USAGE["seconds"] += time.monotonic() - started
            print(f"[clef] {response.status_code} {time.monotonic() - started:.1f}s {tokens} tokens", flush=True)
            return data["answers"]
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"[clef] failed ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})", flush=True)
            if attempt < retries:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
    return None


def options_from_view(view: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The links and buttons of a page view by ref, each with the words of its row, for a `choice` question."""
    options: dict[str, str] = {}
    lines = view.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        matches = list(ELEMENT.finditer(line))
        if not matches:
            continue
        row = ELEMENT.sub(lambda m: m.group(3).strip(), line).strip()
        if len(ELEMENT.sub("", line).strip(" |-")) < 3 and i:  # a row of bare controls: name what precedes it
            row = f"{lines[i - 1].strip()[:120]} / {row}"
        for m in matches:
            options[m.group(1)] = f"{m.group(2)} {m.group(3).strip()}  (row: {row[:240]})"
    return options


async def choose(view: str, goal: str, options: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
    """Which option (by key) best serves `goal` on this view, and Clef's probability for it."""
    options = options or options_from_view(view)
    if not options:
        return None
    answers = await decide({"goal": goal, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]},
                           {"pick": {"type": "choice", "instructions": f"Which element should be used next to reach "
                                     f"the goal: {goal}", "criteria": options}})
    if not answers:
        return None
    pick = answers["pick"]
    return pick["choice"], pick.get("probabilities", {}).get(pick["choice"], pick.get("confidence", 0.0))


async def yes(state, question: str) -> float | None:
    """Clef's probability that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}})
    return None if answers is None else answers["q"]["noul"]


async def yes_each(state, questions: list[str]) -> list[float] | None:
    """Several yes/no questions about one state in one call (e.g. one per list row), in order."""
    answers = await decide(state, {f"q{i}": {"type": "noul", "instructions": q} for i, q in enumerate(questions)})
    return None if answers is None else [answers[f"q{i}"]["noul"] for i in range(len(questions))]


OUTCOME_QUESTION = ("Is this page an error, an empty result, a locked or expired state, a dead end or a decoy, rather "
                    "than real content that moves the task on? Last action: {action}")


async def page_check(ctx: RunContext, last_action: str) -> str:
    """Ask a fast second opinion whether the current page is an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action.

    Use it when unsure whether your last action worked, before relying on the page. `last_action` says what you
    did and expected, e.g. "searched the archive for the tender reference".
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    p = await yes({"last_action": last_action, "url": session.page.url, "page": session.view[:MAX_STATE]},
                  OUTCOME_QUESTION.format(action=last_action))
    session.trace.event(session.name, "clef", check="outcome", action=last_action[:120], p_error=p)
    if p is None:
        return "No second opinion available; judge the page yourself."
    if p >= 0.5:
        return f"Likely an error, empty, locked or decoy page (p={p:.2f}): go back or try another way."
    return f"Likely real content (p_error={p:.2f}); the action seems to have worked."


def tools() -> tuple:
    """Extra worker tools when Clef is on; pass to run_worker(tools=...)."""
    return (page_check,) if enabled() else ()

"""
Quick decisions with Cloudflare Clef, the hosted decision model, beside Qwen.

Clef answers fixed-form questions about a state in about a second: `choice` picks one of our options, `noul` gives the
probability of yes. Off unless AGENT_CLEF=1 (or USE_CLEF=1), so runs with and without it compare side by side; ship
it on only with "clef" in agent.json "models". Every helper returns None when Clef fails, and the caller goes on
without it.

Measured on hand-labelled page views (dev/clef_eval/RESULTS.md): Clef loses to Qwen without thinking at picking a
link and at judging whether a record is the right one (ordering, look-alike references, numbers), but it is exact and
fast at "is this an error, empty, locked or decoy page after my action", where Qwen without thinking slips. So the
only agent use is that check: the `page_check` tool, and `outcome_hint` for a hook after actions.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time

import httpx2 as httpx
from pydantic_ai import RunContext

TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get("CLEF_TIMEOUT", "20"))
MAX_STATE = 12000  # characters of page text sent; Clef reads text far shorter than Qwen's context
_limit = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("CLEF_CONCURRENCY", "12")))  # team limit is 16 at once
USAGE = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0, "seconds": 0.0}  # this process's Clef use, for the trace and cost
ELEMENT = re.compile(r"\[(e\d+) (link|button|summary|tab|menuitem)\b([^\]]*)\]")


def enabled() -> bool:
    on = os.environ.get("AGENT_CLEF", os.environ.get("USE_CLEF", "0")) == "1"
    return on and bool(os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"))


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[str] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict | None:
    """One /v1/decide call: the raw answers by question key, or None after `retries` failed attempts."""
    if not os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"):
        return None
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = images[:4]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('CLEF_API_KEY', '')}", "User-Agent": "error404ai-rfq-agent"}
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            async with _limit, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=TIMEOUT) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            tokens = data.get("usage", {}).get("input_tokens", 0)
            USAGE["calls"] += 1
            USAGE["input_tokens"] += tokens
            USAGE["seconds"] += time.monotonic() - started
            print(f"[clef] {response.status_code} {time.monotonic() - started:.1f}s {tokens} tokens", flush=True)
            return data["answers"]
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"[clef] failed ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})", flush=True)
            if attempt < retries:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
    return None


def options_from_view(view: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The links and buttons of a page view by ref, each with the words of its row, for a `choice` question."""
    options: dict[str, str] = {}
    lines = view.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        matches = list(ELEMENT.finditer(line))
        if not matches:
            continue
        row = ELEMENT.sub(lambda m: m.group(3).strip(), line).strip()
        if len(ELEMENT.sub("", line).strip(" |-")) < 3 and i:  # a row of bare controls: name what precedes it
            row = f"{lines[i - 1].strip()[:120]} / {row}"
        for m in matches:
            options[m.group(1)] = f"{m.group(2)} {m.group(3).strip()}  (row: {row[:240]})"
    return options


async def choose(view: str, goal: str, options: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
    """Which option (by key) best serves `goal` on this view, and Clef's probability for it."""
    options = options or options_from_view(view)
    if not options:
        return None
    answers = await decide({"goal": goal, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]},
                           {"pick": {"type": "choice", "instructions": f"Which element should be used next to reach "
                                     f"the goal: {goal}", "criteria": options}})
    if not answers:
        return None
    pick = answers["pick"]
    return pick["choice"], pick.get("probabilities", {}).get(pick["choice"], pick.get("confidence", 0.0))


async def yes(state, question: str) -> float | None:
    """Clef's probability that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}})
    return None if answers is None else answers["q"]["noul"]


async def yes_each(state, questions: list[str]) -> list[float] | None:
    """Several yes/no questions about one state in one call (e.g. one per list row), in order."""
    answers = await decide(state, {f"q{i}": {"type": "noul", "instructions": q} for i, q in enumerate(questions)})
    return None if answers is None else [answers[f"q{i}"]["noul"] for i in range(len(questions))]


OUTCOME_QUESTION = ("Is this page an error, an empty result, a locked or expired state, a dead end or a decoy, rather "
                    "than real content that moves the task on? Last action: {action}")


async def page_check(ctx: RunContext, last_action: str) -> str:
    """Ask a fast second opinion whether the current page is an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action.

    Use it when unsure whether your last action worked, before relying on the page. `last_action` says what you
    did and expected, e.g. "searched the archive for the tender reference".
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    p = await yes({"last_action": last_action, "url": session.page.url, "page": session.view[:MAX_STATE]},
                  OUTCOME_QUESTION.format(action=last_action))
    session.trace.event(session.name, "clef", check="outcome", action=last_action[:120], p_error=p)
    if p is None:
        return "No second opinion available; judge the page yourself."
    if p >= 0.5:
        return f"Likely an error, empty, locked or decoy page (p={p:.2f}): go back or try another way."
    return f"Likely real content (p_error={p:.2f}); the action seems to have worked."


def tools() -> tuple:
    """Extra worker tools when Clef is on; pass to run_worker(tools=...)."""
    return (page_check,) if enabled() else ()

"""
Quick decisions with Cloudflare Clef, the hosted decision model, beside Qwen.

Clef answers fixed-form questions about a state in about a second: `choice` picks one of our options, `noul` gives the
probability of yes. Off unless AGENT_CLEF=1 (or USE_CLEF=1), so runs with and without it compare side by side; ship
it on only with "clef" in agent.json "models". Every helper returns None when Clef fails, and the caller goes on
without it.

Measured on hand-labelled page views (dev/clef_eval/RESULTS.md): Clef loses to Qwen without thinking at picking a
link and at judging whether a record is the right one (ordering, look-alike references, numbers), but it is exact and
fast at "is this an error, empty, locked or decoy page after my action", where Qwen without thinking slips. So the
only agent use is that check: the `page_check` tool, and `outcome_hint` for a hook after actions.
"""
import asyncio
import os
import re
import time

import httpx2 as httpx
from pydantic_ai import RunContext

TIMEOUT = float(os.environ.get("CLEF_TIMEOUT", "20"))
MAX_STATE = 12000  # characters of page text sent; Clef reads text far shorter than Qwen's context
_limit = asyncio.Semaphore(int(os.environ.get("CLEF_CONCURRENCY", "12")))  # team limit is 16 at once
USAGE = {"calls": 0, "input_tokens": 0, "seconds": 0.0}  # this process's Clef use, for the trace and cost
ELEMENT = re.compile(r"\[(e\d+) (link|button|summary|tab|menuitem)\b([^\]]*)\]")


def enabled() -> bool:
    on = os.environ.get("AGENT_CLEF", os.environ.get("USE_CLEF", "0")) == "1"
    return on and bool(os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"))


async def decide(state, questions: dict, images: list[str] | None = None, retries: int = 2) -> dict | None:
    """One /v1/decide call: the raw answers by question key, or None after `retries` failed attempts."""
    if not os.environ.get("CLEF_BASE_URL"):
        return None
    body = {"state": state, "questions": questions}
    if images:
        body["images"] = images[:4]
    url = os.environ["CLEF_BASE_URL"].rstrip("/") + "/v1/decide"
    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {os.environ.get('CLEF_API_KEY', '')}", "User-Agent": "error404ai-rfq-agent"}
    for attempt in range(retries + 1):
        started = time.monotonic()
        try:
            async with _limit, httpx.AsyncClient(timeout=TIMEOUT) as client:
                response = await client.post(url, json=body, headers=headers)
            response.raise_for_status()
            data = response.json()
            tokens = data.get("usage", {}).get("input_tokens", 0)
            USAGE["calls"] += 1
            USAGE["input_tokens"] += tokens
            USAGE["seconds"] += time.monotonic() - started
            print(f"[clef] {response.status_code} {time.monotonic() - started:.1f}s {tokens} tokens", flush=True)
            return data["answers"]
        except Exception as error:
            print(f"[clef] failed ({type(error).__name__}: {str(error)[:120]})", flush=True)
            if attempt < retries:
                await asyncio.sleep(0.5 * (attempt + 1))
    return None


def options_from_view(view: str) -> dict[str, str]:
    """The links and buttons of a page view by ref, each with the words of its row, for a `choice` question."""
    options: dict[str, str] = {}
    lines = view.splitlines()
    for i, line in enumerate(lines):
        matches = list(ELEMENT.finditer(line))
        if not matches:
            continue
        row = ELEMENT.sub(lambda m: m.group(3).strip(), line).strip()
        if len(ELEMENT.sub("", line).strip(" |-")) < 3 and i:  # a row of bare controls: name what precedes it
            row = f"{lines[i - 1].strip()[:120]} / {row}"
        for m in matches:
            options[m.group(1)] = f"{m.group(2)} {m.group(3).strip()}  (row: {row[:240]})"
    return options


async def choose(view: str, goal: str, options: dict[str, str] | None = None) -> tuple[str, float] | None:
    """Which option (by key) best serves `goal` on this view, and Clef's probability for it."""
    options = options or options_from_view(view)
    if not options:
        return None
    answers = await decide({"goal": goal, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]},
                           {"pick": {"type": "choice", "instructions": f"Which element should be used next to reach "
                                     f"the goal: {goal}", "criteria": options}})
    if not answers:
        return None
    pick = answers["pick"]
    return pick["choice"], pick.get("probabilities", {}).get(pick["choice"], pick.get("confidence", 0.0))


async def yes(state, question: str) -> float | None:
    """Clef's probability that the answer to a yes/no question about `state` is yes."""
    answers = await decide(state, {"q": {"type": "noul", "instructions": question}})
    return None if answers is None else answers["q"]["noul"]


async def yes_each(state, questions: list[str]) -> list[float] | None:
    """Several yes/no questions about one state in one call (e.g. one per list row), in order."""
    answers = await decide(state, {f"q{i}": {"type": "noul", "instructions": q} for i, q in enumerate(questions)})
    return None if answers is None else [answers[f"q{i}"]["noul"] for i in range(len(questions))]


OUTCOME_QUESTION = ("Is this page an error, an empty result, a locked or expired state, a dead end or a decoy, rather "
                    "than real content that moves the task on? Last action: {action}")


async def dead_end(view: str, action: str) -> float | None:
    """Clef's probability that `view`, seen after `action`, is an error, empty, locked or decoy page."""
    return await yes({"last_action": action, "page": view[:MAX_STATE]}, OUTCOME_QUESTION.format(action=action))


async def outcome_hint(view: str, action: str) -> str:
    """A line to put above a view when Clef finds it a dead end after `action` (threshold 0.5), else ""."""
    p = await dead_end(view, action) if enabled() else None
    return "" if p is None or p < 0.5 else (f"Check: this looks like an error, empty, locked or decoy page after "
                                             f"{action} (p={p:.2f}); go back or try another way.")


async def page_check(ctx: RunContext, last_action: str) -> str:
    """Ask a fast second opinion whether the current page is an error, empty, locked or decoy page after an action.

    Use it when unsure whether your last action worked, before relying on the page. `last_action` says what you
    did and expected, e.g. "searched the archive for the tender reference".
    """
    session = ctx.deps.session
    p = await dead_end(session.view, last_action)
    session.trace.event(session.name, "clef", check="outcome", action=last_action[:120], p_error=p)
    if p is None:
        return "No second opinion available; judge the page yourself."
    if p >= 0.5:
        return f"Likely an error, empty, locked or decoy page (p={p:.2f}): go back or try another way."
    return f"Likely real content (p_error={p:.2f}); the action seems to have worked."


def tools() -> tuple:
    """Extra worker tools when Clef is on; pass to run_worker(tools=...)."""
    return (page_check,) if enabled() else ()

# Clef vs Qwen on agent decisions

2026-10-10, local proxy. Eval set: page views from our own local-run traces (public-1), hand-labelled, kept in
`data/` (gitignored: it holds site text). `data/build.py` makes `items.json`; `eval.py` runs it.
Each item: same page text and question for every model. Clef via `agent/clef.py`; Qwen
(`qwen3.8-flash-next`) as one chat call, thinking off or on.

Decision types:

- `choice`: which link or control on a view serves a goal (14 items; options = every link and button with its row).
- `noul_doc`: right document, current revision, exact reference, record dated no later than the scenario date,
  quantity stated (16 items).
- `noul_outcome`: is the page an error, empty result, locked, dead-end or decoy page after the last action (20 items).
- `prefilter`: which rows of a list (Q&A answers, mails, tenders) match a criterion (5 lists, 18 row decisions);
  Clef answers all rows of a list in one call with one `noul` question per row.

## Results (3 repeats each)

| Type | Model | Accuracy | Median s | p90 s | $ per decision |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| choice | Clef | 79 % (33/42) | 1.4 | 2.0 | 0.00028 |
| choice | Qwen, thinking off | **93 %** (39/42) | 1.3 | 2.0 | 0.00013 |
| choice | Qwen, thinking on | 86 % (36/42) | 6.4 | 106 (hang) | 0.00044 |
| noul_doc | Clef | 88 % (42/48) | 1.1 | 1.6 | 0.00028 |
| noul_doc | Qwen, thinking off | 92 % (44/48) | 1.1 | 2.0 | 0.00013 |
| noul_doc | Qwen, thinking on | **98 %** (47/48) | 5.2 | 10.5 | 0.00044 |
| noul_outcome | Clef | **100 %** (60/60) | 1.1 | 1.6 | 0.00015 |
| noul_outcome | Qwen, thinking off | 93 % (56/60) | 1.4 | 2.4 | 0.00008 |
| noul_outcome | Qwen, thinking on (14 items) | 100 % (42/42) | 4.3 | 10.3 | 0.00044 |
| prefilter | Clef | 100 % (54/54) | 1.1 | 1.6 | 0.00028 per list |
| prefilter | Qwen, thinking off | 100 % (54/54) | 1.2 | 5.2 | 0.00013 per list |
| prefilter | Qwen, thinking on | 100 % (54/54) | 5.7 | 14.2 | 0.00044 per list |

Cost is the simulated price: Clef $0.24 per M input tokens (~1.1k tokens per page view), Qwen $0.15 in /
$0.47 out. All are negligible next to a worker step (~10k+ tokens); latency and accuracy decide.

## Where Clef helps and where not

- Clef is deterministic: the same misses on every repeat. Qwen off varies between repeats.
- **Outcome checks: Clef wins.** 60/60 with a wide margin (dead ends p >= 0.68, real pages p <= 0.09) at ~1 s.
  Qwen without thinking missed an unloaded reading pane every time and a "TAN requested" page once; Qwen with
  thinking is also exact but 4x slower.
- **Link choice: Clef loses.** It misses choices that need ordering or reading a row's tooltip: "highest request
  number" (picks a lower one), "the newest is on the previous page", "the revision marked valid in a tooltip".
- **Right document / record: Clef loses** to Qwen with thinking. It took a look-alike reference (`<ref>-A`) for the
  exact one and misread a stated quantity; Qwen off also fell for the look-alike.
- **Pre-filtering rows: tie** (all 100 %). No gain over Qwen, and Qwen already reads short lists in one step.

## Integrated

Only the outcome check, off by default: `AGENT_CLEF=1` (alias `USE_CLEF=1`; the `AGENT_` prefix is recorded by
`dev/track.py`) gives every worker a `page_check(last_action)` tool. `clef.outcome_hint(view, action)` is ready for an
automatic check after actions, not wired in. Not yet measured inside a full run.
